commits.message:
[TritonToLinalg](fix) preserve indirect memory access order (#2172)

Place scalar loops at the original load or store instead of the addptr.
Hoisting an indirect store can put it before its value or mask definitions,
while hoisting an indirect load can move it before a preceding store.

Anchor insertion after the memory operation because the loop body builder
moves that operation before the outer loop is inserted. Add compiler and
NPU regressions for operand dominance, conditional stores and load order.

commits.comment: [OpClassifier] 修复 iter_args init 被错误克隆为 VECTOR 的问题。当 scf.for 的 iter_args init 在循环体中被 CUBE matmul 作为 outs 消费、而循环 yield 流出到外部 VECTOR op 时，propagateVectorUpstream 会通过循环 operands 把 VECTOR 反向传播到 init，导致 init 变成 CUBE_AND_VECTOR 并被 Step 7 拆分，VECTOR 克隆绑定到 iter_args 而 body 仍需要 CUBE 原件，原件变死代码。修复方式：BFS 遇到 LoopLikeOpInterface 时，跳过 iter_args init 的 defining op；例外是 VECTOR 产生的 recurrence（yield 值来自真正的 VECTOR 计算 op），此时 init 必须保持 VECTOR 可着色以便 Step 7 拆分。新增 isVectorProducerOp 排除 region container。修复逻辑合理，但例外判定依赖 getLoopCarriedDefOp 与 isTensorArithOrMathOp，需保证两者语义与新引入的 scope.scope 原子语义不冲突。

commits.message:
[ssbuffer]fix: OpClassifier wrongly clones iter_args init as VECTOR (#2802)

When a scf.for loop has an iter_args init consumed as the `outs` of a CUBE
linalg.matmul inside the body, but the loop's yielded value flows into a
VECTOR arith op outside the loop, propagateVectorUpstream would propagate
VECTOR onto the init through the loop's operands. The init then became
CUBE_AND_VECTOR and was split: a VECTOR clone was bound to iter_args while
the body still needed the CUBE original — which became dead code.

Fix: propagateVectorUpstream now skips iter_args init defining ops when BFS
reaches a scf.for / scf.while, so an init's classification is driven by its
body-side consumers; VECTOR from the loop's external consumers no longer
leaks onto it.

Exception: a VECTOR-produced recurrence — the value yielded back comes from
a genuine VECTOR compute op while CUBE users merely read it (e.g. matmul
ins) — must keep its init VECTOR-colorable so Step 7 splits it and binds the
VECTOR clone to the loop. The recurrence's producer is looked up with the
existing CVPipeline::getLoopCarriedDefOp helper; the new private predicate
isVectorProducerOp excludes region containers, because the default sweep
marks them VECTOR even when their body is CUBE.

commits.comment: [SplitIfByBlockId] 重构 yield carrier 规划。原实现让『最后一个 split-if』重新 yield 每一个原始 slot，导致由上游 group 产生的 slot 作为纯 passthrough 穿过它。新实现引入 SlotKind 四分类（Delegated/NativeLast/Relay/External），planYieldCaseB 一次性决定每个 slot 的 carrier group，materialization 用单一 per-group 循环把 source if 的 result uses 重定向到记录的 carrier result；无 carrier 的 slot 视为硬失败而非静默 passthrough。实现思路清晰，用 DominanceInfo 判定 else operand 是否可用（domElse）。风险：所有 slot 都产生于 earlier group 时 last if 退化为 void if，需保证 else region 与 otherCtx 吸收逻辑仍正确；另外 updateCrossValueReplacementGroup 跳过 last group 的理由（External/Relay/NativeLast 三种 hazard）需要在后续 pass 中持续成立。

test_impact.reason: 新增 relay_redirect.mlir（redirect 形状、全重定向 void last if、非委派 relay 形状），并在 commit message 中声称 52 份 DCV UT 输出字节一致、54 条 RUN 通过。

commits.message:
[ssbuffer](fix) split-if: plan the yield carrier per slot instead of relaying through the last if (#2674)

The last split-if used to re-yield every original slot, so a slot produced by
an upstream group travelled through it as a pure passthrough (same condition,
same value). planYieldCaseB now classifies every original slot -- Delegated /
NativeLast / Relay / External -- and derives carrier(s) from that one table, so
a slot is exposed by the group that actually computes it. Materialization is a
single per-group loop that re-points the source if's result uses at the recorded
carrier results; a slot without a carrier is a hard failure, never a silent
pass-through.

Behaviour is unchanged where no slot can be redirected: 52 DCV UT files dump
byte-identical pass output, 54 RUN-line checks pass, and relay_redirect.mlir
pins the redirect, the fully redirected (void last if) and the non-delegable
relay shapes.

commits.message:
[ascend](chore) update npuir submodule and patch fix code (#2826)

* [build](feat) npuir update

* [ascend](fix): stop TLA builder from shadowing cann scope/custom-op paths

Motivation: ebf950ff5 mounted the TLA builder for every kernel, and its
setup_unified_builder re-attached methods already owned by the cann
extension plus reassigned main_builder._ascend_builder.  That made the
TLA create_scope_op (which auto-emplaces the region entry block) shadow
the cann version, so al.scope handlers ended up with two blocks in the
scope.scope region ('op expects region #0 to have 0 or 1 blocks'), and
al.custom, which resolves the builder via
getattr(_semantic.builder, '_ascend_builder'), silently swapped the
underlying pybind instance for every cann kernel.

Design: Only TLA-specific methods are attached now; the 8 methods shared
with the cann extension (create_scope_op, scope_return,
create_annotation_mark, get_array_attr, is_simt_mode, get_i64_array_attr,
get_buffer_ty, get_buffer_ty_with_strides) are left to the cann
setup_unified_builder, and main_builder._ascend_builder is no longer
reassigned.  The entry-block emplace moves from create_scope_op into the
TLA-only get_scope_entry_block, so TLA scopes still get their body while
non-TLA scopes keep a single block.  parse_attr stays attached because
the cann extension does not mount it on main_builder and TLA mlir_attrs
depends on it.

Risks: TLA scopes now rely on get_scope_entry_block for the entry block;
covered by the tla_ut IR regression (30 passed).

Assisted-by: AI

* [ascend](feat) refresh npuir submodule and AVE dialect support

Motivation: TLA SIMD codegen emits ave.hir.* ops through tla_builder.cc, so
the Ascend plugin must load the HIVMAVE (AVE) dialect and link
MLIRAVEDialect, and tla_builder.cc must be part of the plugin build. Keep
third_party/ascend/AscendNPU-IR on origin/stable 4eb12142 (the latest
10.28 sync, sync1028/bfaba0ec), which supersedes the local temporary
branch commits.

Design: move the AscendNPU-IR gitlink from bb13ef612 (local
init-tla-full-cube-rebase-temp tip) to 4eb12142; register
mlir::hivmave::AVEDialect in ascend_ir.cc and link MLIRAVEDialect; add
language/tla/cpp/tla_builder.cc to the TritonAscend plugin and bind
init_tla_builder in triton_ascend.cc. The community patch is left
untouched: the TLA builder is mounted by tla.compiler.ast_to_ttir itself,
not by the patched code_generator.

Risks: moving from the master bugfix line (46914c6ad) to the stable sync
line (4eb12142) is a 162-file difference including llvm-project; tla_ut
offline IR must be re-validated against a libtriton rebuilt from the new
submodule.

Assisted-by: AI

* [ascend](feat) add @tla.jit and stamp hacc.mode at TLA IR lowering

Motivation: TLA mode was previously selected by callers passing
enable_tla_mode explicitly or through a patch on JITFunction.run; that
runtime machinery is fragile and invisible to the offline ast_to_ttir
entry. The backend compiler already reads module attributes (hacc.target),
so TLA mode should travel the same way.

Design: tla.jit is a plain triton.jit alias, so it needs no per-kernel
marker. tla.compiler.lower_ttir stamps hacc.mode = "tla" unconditionally on
every module it lowers, and since that entry point is only reached by the
TLA offline flow, the stamp requires no decorator coupling, no monkeypatch
of the community ast_to_ttir, and no idempotency flag; the offline
ast_to_ttir keeps injecting hacc.target beside it. register_with_dispatch()
merges TLA_WITH_DISPATCH into the community WITH_DISPATCH registry from
setup_unified_builder, keeping the "with tla.scope.*" wiring self-contained.
tla_ut kernels are decorated with @tla.jit.

Risks: runtime-compiled kernels no longer receive hacc.mode because the
runtime path does not go through lower_ttir; stamp it beside the runtime
hacc.target injection once the backend consumes the attribute.

Assisted-by: AI

* [ascend](feat): route @tla.jit kernels through the TLA frontend and stamp kernel mode

Motivation: _infer_tla_kernel_mode ran only on the TLA offline path
(lower_ttir), so runtime @tla.jit kernels reached bishengir-compile without
hivm.func_core_type / mix_mode / module_core_type / vf_mode markers and never
carried the enable_tla_mode flag for bishengir-compile.

Design: reintroduce TLASTSource/TLAJITFunction so @tla.jit kernels build TTIR
through the same ast_to_ttir entry as the offline tla_ut flow.
TLASTSource.make_ir sets the init=False NPUOptions.enable_tla_mode flag (never
a launch argument), which ttir_to_linalg uses to run _infer_tla_kernel_mode
and which linalg_to_bin forwards to bishengir-compile as
--enable-tla-mode=true.  Extend _infer_tla_kernel_mode to stamp
hivm.vf_mode<MIX> on the entry when a SIMT scope is present.  Tests keep the
FFTS cross-core flags, write O from L0C straight to GM (fixpipe) to drop the
extra handoff, and use static_range in the softmax/bias row loops.

Risks: non-TLA kernels keep enable_tla_mode=False and skip both the kernel
mode stamping and the new compiler flag; init=False excludes the field from
launch keywords and the cache key; re-stamping at the ttadapter boundary is
idempotent.

Assisted-by: AI

* [ascend](fix): tolerate opt without enable_tla_mode in backend paths

Motivation: pytest_ut constructs SimpleNamespace opt objects without the
enable_tla_mode field, so the direct opt.enable_tla_mode access in
ttir_to_linalg and linalg_to_bin_enable_npu_compile_910_95 raises
AttributeError on those tests.

Design: read the flag via getattr(opt, "enable_tla_mode", False), keeping
the default False for non-TLA kernels while leaving real NPUOptions
behavior unchanged.

Risks: None.

Assisted-by: AI

commits.comment: CI 基础设施清理：删除所有工作流与 Dockerfile 中对内部 nginx-pypi-cache 集群服务的引用（PIP_INDEX_URL / PIP_TRUSTED_HOST / APTMIRROR / TORCH_INDEX_URL），保留公共的 PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL（华为云 Ascend pypi 源）。改动覆盖 build-docker-image.yml（移除 4 个 build-args）、llvm-build.yml（去掉 APT 源 sed 重写并重命名步骤）、almalinux.Dockerfile / wheels.Dockerfile（去掉内部 PIP 源，保留 PIP_TIMEOUT）、以及 documentation/integration-tests-ascend/npuir-build/sync-upstream/wheels 等多个 workflow 的 env。动机是 CI runner 已可通过 cluster squid 代理访问公网源，内部镜像不再需要。风险主要为 CI 环境依赖：需确认各 Dockerfile 与 workflow 在无内网缓存时能从公共源（Huawei Cloud apt/pypi、PyTorch CPU index）正常安装依赖，且不引入下载超时/限流问题；对外部贡献者与 fork 构建反而更友好。不涉及 Ascend 后端代码。

test_impact.reason: 仅修改 CI 工作流与 Dockerfile 的包源配置，不改变源码、编译流水线或运行时逻辑，也未改变测试执行方式与用例集合；无需新增/更新测试用例。

commits.message:
ci: remove internal cache-service references (#2795)

CI runners reach public sources through the cluster squid proxy, so the
internal nginx-pypi-cache mirror is no longer needed.

- Drop PIP_INDEX_URL / PIP_TRUSTED_HOST pointing at the internal host in
  all workflows; public PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL entries are kept
- llvm-build.yml: drop the APT source rewriting and rename the step
- build-docker-image.yml: drop APTMIRROR / PIP_INDEX_URL / PIP_TRUSTED_HOST
  / TORCH_INDEX_URL build args; docker/Dockerfile already defaults to the
  public Huawei Cloud apt/pypi mirrors and the public PyTorch CPU index
- almalinux.Dockerfile / wheels.Dockerfile: drop internal PIP_INDEX_URL /
  PIP_TRUSTED_HOST, keep PIP_TIMEOUT
